checks.text: In the "Events" tab, clicking the button "New event" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Title" with "Team Sync", the field labelled "Date" with "2025-03-15", the field labelled "Start time" with "09:00", the field labelled "End time" with "10:00", and clicking "Save" adds an event. The month grid for March 2025 shows a chip on the 15th containing "Team Sync".

In the "Events" tab, with the event "Team Sync" on 2025-03-15 present, clicking the chip "Team Sync" opens the event detail. Clicking the button "Delete" removes the event, and the month grid for March 2025 no longer shows a chip on the 15th.

In the "Events" tab, creating an event with Title "Weekly Standup", Date "2025-03-10", Start time "09:00", End time "09:15", and selecting "Weekly" in the select labelled "Recurrence" creates an event. The month grid for March 2025 shows chips containing "Weekly Standup" on the 10th, 17th, 24th, and 31st.

In the "Timeline" tab, clicking the button "New task" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Name" with "Design Phase", the field labelled "Start" with "2025-03-01", the field labelled "End" with "2025-03-14", and clicking "Save" adds a Gantt bar. The timeline shows a bar labelled "Design Phase" spanning from March 1 to March 14.

In the "Timeline" tab, with the task "Design Phase" present, clicking the button "Export ICS" copies an ICS string to the clipboard. The clipboard content contains "BEGIN:VEVENT" and "SUMMARY:Design Phase".

In the "Events" tab, with the event "Team Sync" on 2025-03-15 present, clicking the button "Export ICS" copies an ICS string to the clipboard. The clipboard content contains "BEGIN:VEVENT" and "SUMMARY:Team Sync".

In the "Timeline" tab, with the task "Design Phase" from 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-14 present, dragging the right edge of the bar to extend the end date to 2025-03-20 updates the task. The timeline shows a bar labelled "Design Phase" spanning from March 1 to March 20.
Reload keeps the event "Team Sync" on 2025-03-15 and the task "Design Phase" in the timeline.
